strings: After a short while, m_c has calmed back down, no longer worrying about a threat that's not there.
m_c has spent the time talking with {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates and has realized that there's nothing to worry about.
Despite some lingering anxiety, m_c has calmed down and is able to feel secure in the knowledge that the Clan is safe.
m_c feels much better after some rest and time spent watching the Clan thrive.
